fiber_complete_context: child-resolved preparations/effects and heat records for an open time interval
theorem: Block functional calculus gives f(A_tilde)=R f(A)R* direct-sum f(B). Hence every coarse record is independent of arbitrary symmetric changes delta B: the declared blindness kernel is Sym(12), dimension 78. If a fiber-complete context records exp(-tB) on an open interval, differentiation at t=0 recovers B and the kernel collapses to zero. Operational depth is therefore instrument-relative, not a layer number alone.
